data.value: Before the flight, check whether the zone is active (NOTAM, SIA). If it is, go around it or contact the body given before entering. If in doubt, avoid it.

data.name: AirspaceGuide_CTA_region_de_controle_espace
data.value: CTA (control area): controlled airspace at altitude, above a floor. Neighbour of the TMA but more general, often higher.

data.name: AirspaceGuide_CTR_zone_de_controle_espace
data.value: CTR (control zone): controlled airspace around an important aerodrome, from the ground up to a given height. The controller handles take-offs, landings and arrivals there.

data.name: AirspaceGuide_Clairance_du_controle_et_radio
data.value: ATC clearance and radio required for all (IFR and VFR). IFR flights are separated from each other; VFR flights receive traffic information. Common class around controlled aerodromes.

data.value: ATC clearance required for all. IFR flights are separated from all; a VFR flight receives traffic information on other VFR flights.

data.name: AirspaceGuide_Controle_pour_les_IFR_mais
data.value: Controlled for IFR, but a VFR flight may fly in it without clearance (radio is not mandatory). ATC gives traffic information when possible.

data.name: AirspaceGuide_Ecoute_la_frequence_avant_d
data.value: Listen to the frequency before entering and announce your position and intentions. No clearance is required.

data.value: ATC clearance required for all flights. Class B does not exist in France; class C is rare there for VFR flight.

data.name: Glossary_Clairance_et_radio_obligatoires_pour
data.value: Clearance and radio required for all. This is the usual class of CTRs and many TMAs.

data.name: Glossary_Communications_radio_entre_le_pilote
data.value: Radio communications between the pilot and ATC.

data.name: Glossary_Controle_les_arrivees_et_departs
data.value: Controls instrument arrivals and departures and provides services in the TMA.

data.name: Glossary_Controle_les_decollages_et_atterrissages
data.value: Controls take-offs and landings and traffic around the aerodrome.

data.name: Glossary_Controle_pour_les_IFR_un
data.value: Controlled for IFR; a VFR flight may fly in it without clearance, radio not being mandatory.

data.name: Glossary_Debut_de_la_partie_de
data.value: Start of the part of the runway usable for landing.

data.name: Glossary_Depart_et_arrivee_en_bleu
data.value: Departure and arrival in blue, intermediate points in red, numbered in order. A click on a point removes it.

data.name: Glossary_Designe_un_avion_un_helicoptere
data.value: Means an aeroplane, helicopter, glider, microlight…

data.name: Glossary_Direction_a_tenir_avec_l
data.value: Direction to hold with the aircraft to follow the route despite the wind.

data.name: Glossary_Direction_de_la_route_par
data.value: Direction of the route relative to geographic north.

data.name: Glossary_Donne_la_distance_en_NM
data.value: Gives the distance in NM to a beacon. Often paired with a VOR.

data.name: Glossary_Donnee_en_metres_9999_10
data.value: Given in metres (9999 = 10 km or more) or in kilometres.

data.name: Glossary_ETA_heure_d_arrivee_prevue
data.value: ETA: estimated time of arrival. ETD: estimated time of departure. ETE: estimated time en route.

data.name: Glossary_Ecart_entre_le_nord_geographique
data.value: Difference between geographic north and magnetic north, expressed in degrees East or West.

data.name: Glossary_Elle_fixe_les_codes_utilises
data.value: It sets the codes used everywhere: four-letter aerodrome identifiers (LFPN, LFPL…), charts, units.

data.name: Glossary_Ensemble_des_services_rendus_aux
data.value: All the services provided to aircraft: control, flight information, alerting.

data.name: Glossary_Espace_controle_du_sol_jusqu
data.value: Controlled airspace from the ground up to a given height, around an important aerodrome. ATC clearance is needed to enter.

data.name: Glossary_Espace_controle_en_altitude_au
data.value: Controlled airspace at altitude above one or more aerodromes, for arrivals and departures. Its floor is at altitude: below it, you are outside the zone.

data.name: Glossary_Espace_controle_en_altitude_voisin
data.value: Controlled airspace at altitude, neighbour of the TMA but more general, often higher.

data.name: Glossary_Espaces_controles_a_moyenne_ou
data.value: Controlled airspace at medium or high altitude (LTA: low levels, UTA: high levels).

data.name: Glossary_Espaces_controles_la_classe_et
data.value: Controlled airspaces: the class and limits are written along the line.

data.name: Glossary_FEW_1_a_2_huitiemes
data.value: FEW: 1 to 2 eighths, SCT: 3 to 4, BKN: 5 to 7 (broken), OVC: 8 (overcast). The number that follows is the height of the base in hundreds of feet.

data.name: Glossary_Frequence_d_auto_information_entre
data.value: Self-information frequency between aircraft when there is no unit ("air-air 123.50").

data.name: Glossary_Gere_la_circulation_des_avions
data.value: Manages aircraft traffic on taxiways and parking areas.

data.name: Glossary_Grands_decoupages_du_ciel_dans
data.value: Large divisions of the sky in which a flight information and alerting service is provided. No constraint for a simple VFR flight.

data.name: Glossary_Guidage_radio_precis_vers_la
data.value: Precise radio guidance to the runway, used in IFR. Outside IFR, it also serves as a centreline reference.

data.name: Glossary_Hauteur_mesuree_a_partir_du
data.value: Height measured from the terrain being overflown. "500ft GND" means 500 ft above the ground, wherever it is.

data.name: Glossary_Heure_d_arrivee_de_depart
data.value: Estimated time of arrival / departure / en route

data.name: Glossary_Il_faut_ecouter_la_frequence
data.value: You must listen to the frequency given and, usually, announce yourself before entering. No clearance is required.

data.name: Glossary_Il_faut_prevenir_l_aerodrome
data.value: You must notify the aerodrome before arrival.

data.name: Glossary_Indiquee_par_son_QFU_arrondi
data.value: Identified by its rounded QFU: runway 25 for a QFU close to 250°. The letters L, R, C: left, right, centre.

data.name: Glossary_LF_designe_la_France_la
data.value: "LF" stands for France, the letter for the type (R, D or P) and the number identifies it. Example: LF-R324 is restricted area no. 324.

data.name: Glossary_L_aerodrome_doit_avoir_donne
data.value: The aerodrome must have agreed before arrival.

data.name: Glossary_L_instrument_de_bord_dont
data.value: The onboard instrument whose needle points to an NDB.

data.name: Glossary_Le_document_officiel_qui_decrit
data.value: The official document describing a country's aerodromes, airspaces and rules.

data.name: Glossary_Le_nom_le_plancher_et
data.value: The name, floor and ceiling are written along the outline, on the inside of the zone. Hovering the line shows the detail.

data.name: Glossary_Le_service_ou_l_aerodrome
data.value: The service or aerodrome is open permanently.

data.name: Glossary_Le_service_qui_donne_les
data.value: The service that gives clearances and separates aircraft in controlled airspace.

data.name: Glossary_Le_transpondeur_doit_etre_allume
data.value: The transponder must be on and set to enter the zone.

data.name: Glossary_Le_vol_n_y_est
data.value: Flight is only allowed under certain conditions (military activity, security, environment). It may be active only at certain times: check before entering.

data.name: Glossary_Les_aeronefs_doivent_etre_identifies
data.value: Aircraft must be identified before entering.

data.name: Glossary_Les_conditions_minimales_de_visibilite
data.value: The minimum conditions of visibility and distance from clouds allow, or not, visual flight.

data.name: Glossary_Limite_qui_part_du_sol
data.value: Limit starting at the ground: the zone begins at ground level.

data.name: Glossary_METAR_emis_en_dehors_de
data.value: METAR issued outside the normal time because the weather changes quickly.

data.name: Glossary_Message_code_qui_donne_le
data.value: Coded message giving the wind, visibility, clouds, temperature and QNH at the time of observation.

data.name: Glossary_Message_qui_signale_un_changement
data.value: Message that reports a temporary change: runway closed, zone activated, crane… To be checked before any real flight (SOFIA-Briefing).

data.name: Glossary_Message_radio_continu_piste_en
data.value: Continuous radio message: runway in use, wind, QNH. Listen before contacting the tower.

data.name: Glossary_Modifications_temporaires_de_l_AIP
data.value: Temporary AIP changes and general information published between two editions.

data.name: Glossary_Navigation_par_positions_calculees_plutot
data.value: Navigation by computed positions rather than by beacons.

data.name: Glossary_Nom_et_limites_de_la
data.value: Name and limits of the zone

data.name: Glossary_Nom_international_du_service_d
data.value: International name of the flight information service (in France: SIV).

data.name: Glossary_On_pilote_avec_les_instruments
data.value: You fly with the instruments, including in clouds. Requires a rating.

data.name: Glossary_On_pilote_en_s_aidant
data.value: You fly using what you see outside: ground, horizon, other aircraft.

data.name: Glossary_On_vole_sous_sa_propre
data.value: You fly on your own responsibility, with or without an information service, looking outside.

data.name: Glossary_Organisme_francais_qui_publie_l
data.value: French body that publishes the AIP, VAC charts and NOTAMs.

data.name: Glossary_Passage_dans_un_espace_controle
data.value: Passing through controlled airspace without landing there, with clearance if the class requires it.

data.name: Glossary_Petit_avion_leger_Certains_aerodromes
data.value: Small light aircraft. Some aerodromes reserve circuits or hours for it.

data.name: Glossary_Planeur_parachutage_voltige_ULM_regarder
data.value: Gliding, parachuting, aerobatics, microlight: look outside.

data.name: Glossary_Point_de_report_d_un
data.value: Reporting point of an aerodrome (read from its VAC chart). A click adds it to the route under the name "ICAO-point".

data.name: Glossary_Point_tournant_ou_repere_pose
data.value: Turning point or reference placed on the route.

data.name: Glossary_Position_et_cap_de_l
data.value: Position and heading of the aircraft, updated once a second when the simulator is running.

data.name: Glossary_Position_officielle_de_l_aerodrome
data.value: Official position of the aerodrome on charts.

data.name: Glossary_Pression_de_reference_1013_25
data.value: Reference pressure (1013.25 hPa) used for flight levels.

data.name: Glossary_Pression_ramenee_au_niveau_de
data.value: Pressure reduced to sea level. Set on the altimeter, it gives the true altitude above the sea.

data.name: Glossary_Prevision_de_la_meteo_sur
data.value: Forecast of the weather at an aerodrome for the coming hours. MSFS Rhumb translates it into plain language.

data.name: Glossary_QDM_cap_magnetique_pour_aller
data.value: QDM: magnetic heading to go to the station. QDR: direction you are in relative to it.

data.name: Glossary_Quatre_feux_a_cote_de
data.value: Four lights beside the runway: two red and two white indicate a good slope.

data.name: Glossary_RMZ_TMZ_ATZ_la_radio
data.value: RMZ, TMZ, ATZ: radio or transponder is requested.

data.name: Glossary_Radiophare_non_directionnel_avec_sa
data.value: Non-directional beacon with its frequency in kHz.

data.name: Glossary_Relevement_magnetique_vers_depuis_une
data.value: Magnetic bearing to / from a station

data.name: Glossary_Repere_connu_village_etang_route
data.value: Known landmark (village, pond, road) where you announce your position on arrival or departure. Designated by one or two letters (N, S, NE, EA…).

data.name: Glossary_Reserve_aux_vols_aux_instruments
data.value: Reserved for instrument flights (IFR). VFR flight is prohibited there in France except with special clearance.

data.name: Glossary_Reservee_a_une_activite_souvent
data.value: Reserved for an activity (often military) when activated. Other aircraft must avoid it during that time.

data.name: Glossary_Restriction_qui_n_existe_que
data.value: Restriction that only exists during a given period, published by NOTAM or aeronautical information.

data.name: Glossary_Rond_sur_un_terrain_sa
data.value: Circle on an airport: its colour gives the weather category (green VFR, blue MVFR, red IFR, purple LIFR, grey: no METAR).

data.name: Glossary_Route_vraie_corrigee_de_la
data.value: True course corrected for magnetic variation: direction to read on the compass, drift aside.

data.name: Glossary_Site_du_SIA_ou_l
data.value: SIA website where you consult NOTAMs and active zones and file a flight plan.

data.name: Glossary_Sur_une_carte_VAC_1500
data.value: On a VAC chart, "1500 ft MAX" forbids exceeding that altitude at this point; "MIN" forbids being lower.

data.name: Glossary_Survol_interdit_sauf_autorisation_speciale
data.value: Overflight prohibited, except with special authorisation.

data.name: Glossary_Terrain_d_aviation_Les_cartes
data.value: Airfield. VAC charts carry the prefix "AD 2".

data.name: Glossary_Trajectoire_standard_autour_de_la
data.value: Standard path around the runway: downwind, base, final. It is flown at a height and on a side set by the chart.

data.name: Glossary_Un_agent_informe_sur_le
data.value: An officer informs about traffic and the runway in use, without giving clearances. The pilot remains responsible.

data.name: Glossary_Un_controleur_donne_des_informations
data.value: A controller gives flight and traffic information on the frequency given. Connecting is useful but not mandatory.

data.name: Glossary_Unite_d_altitude_1_ft
data.value: Unit of altitude: 1 ft = 0.3048 m. 1,000 ft ≈ 305 m.

data.name: Glossary_Unite_de_distance_1_NM
data.value: Unit of distance: 1 NM = 1.852 km, i.e. one minute of arc of latitude.

data.name: Glossary_Unite_de_pression_atmospherique_Au
data.value: Unit of atmospheric pressure. At sea level, the standard pressure is 1013.25 hPa.

data.name: Glossary_VFR_bonnes_conditions_MVFR_marginales
data.value: VFR: good conditions. MVFR: marginal. IFR: poor, visual flight is difficult. LIFR: very poor. MSFS Rhumb shows them by the colour of an airport.

data.name: Glossary_Virages_vers_la_gauche_ou
data.value: Turns to the left or to the right. Left hand is the rule, unless the chart says otherwise.

data.name: Glossary_Visibilite_de_10_km_ou
data.value: Visibility of 10 km or more, no significant cloud below 5,000 ft, no notable phenomenon: very good conditions.

data.name: Glossary_Vitesse_d_un_mille_nautique
data.value: Speed of one nautical mile per hour: 1 kt = 1.852 km/h.

data.name: Glossary_Vitesse_de_l_avion_par
data.value: Speed of the aircraft relative to the ground, wind included.

data.name: Glossary_Vitesse_de_l_avion_par_2
data.value: Speed of the aircraft relative to the air.

data.name: Glossary_Zone_autour_d_un_aerodrome
data.value: Zone around an aerodrome where local traffic is intense: follow the circuit and the radio.
